collection.title: Jaguar XJ 2010 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Jaguar XJ 2010 - 2019 model which requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
